Package com.nexuslink.protocol.mongo

package com.nexuslink.protocol.mongo
  • Class
    Description
    BsonNode
    One row of the document tree: a field name, its value rendered for display, the BSON type it actually holds, and its children when it is a document or an array.
    BsonNode.BsonKind
    The BSON types the tree distinguishes — what Compass's type badge shows.
    BsonValueParser
    Turns the text typed into the tree's Value cell back into a BSON value of a chosen type, and builds the $set update that stores it.
    BsonValueParser.BsonParseException
    Thrown when the text cannot be read as the chosen type — the edit is refused, not coerced.
    ChangeEvent
    One change reported by a change stream, flattened into the fields a log line needs: when, what kind of change, which collection, which document, and what actually changed.
    CollectionDiff
    Compares two collections document by document, matched on _id — Studio 3T's Data Compare, which is the feature people buy that licence for.
    CollectionDiff.Entry
    One reconciled document pair.
    CollectionDiff.Status
    How a document on one side relates to the other side.
    CollectionTransfer
    Turning a collection into a file and back: the pure half of import/export.
    CollectionTransfer.Format
    How a collection is written out, and read back in.
    ExplainSummary
    The three numbers that matter in an explain plan, pulled out of the several hundred lines the server actually returns: which index was used (if any), how many documents were examined, and how many were returned.
    IndexAdvice
    Index diagnostics without an Atlas account: which indexes are actually being used, which are dead weight, and which index the query in the bar would want.
    IndexAdvice.IndexUsage
    One index's usage since the server's counters started.
    MongoConnectionString
    Pure, dependency-free parser for a MongoDB connection string (URI), following the connection-string spec.
    MongoConnectionStringException
    Thrown when a MongoDB connection string cannot be parsed because it violates the MongoDB URI format (missing scheme, empty host list, or an illegal +srv shape).
    MongoExplorer
    Exposes a connected MongoService as a browsable tree:
    MongoFindResult
    A find's result in both shapes the UI needs: the decoded Documents (so the tree view can show true BSON types and edit by _id) and the same documents rendered as shell JSON (for the JSON view and export).
    MongoQueryResult
    Result of a MongoDB read (find / aggregate).
    MongoQuerySpec
    One query as the Compass-style query bar states it: filter, projection, sort, skip and limit.
    MongoServerInfo
    What the connected MongoDB deployment actually is — product, version and topology — and which of the commands this client uses it will accept.
    MongoServerInfo.Topology
    How the deployment is put together, which decides what transactions and reads can do.
    MongoService
    MongoDB client built on the official synchronous driver.
    MongoService.ChangeWatch
    Stops a change-stream watch.
    MongoService.GridFsEntry
    One file stored in a GridFS bucket.
    MongoShellCommand
    A parsed mongosh-style line: db.<collection>.<operation>(<args>) plus any chained modifiers (.sort(...), .limit(...), .skip(...), .count()).
    PipelinePlan
    An aggregation pipeline broken into the prefixes needed to preview it stage by stage: what the documents look like after stage 1, after stages 1–2, and so on.
    PipelinePlan.PipelineException
    Thrown when a stage is not valid JSON or is not a single-key stage document.
    SchemaProfile
    What a sample of documents says the collection's shape is: for every field path, how often it is present, which BSON types it holds and in what proportion, how often it is null, and how many distinct values were seen.
    SchemaProfile.FieldProfile
    One field path's statistics across the sample.
    StagePreview
    What one aggregation stage produced: its operator, how many documents survive it, a sample of those documents, and how the count moved compared with the stage before it.

NexusLink — one console, every protocol, zero context switching.
